clips.title: The story
paras: In Westfall's Dagger Hills, Grimbooze Thunderbrew brews potent spirits and speaks in verse. The eccentric dwarf belongs to the Thunderbrew clan.

Grimbooze Thunderbrew camps in the Dagger Hills, where he tends his private casks. He comes from the Thunderbrew brewing family of Kharanos and left the snowy peaks of Dun Morogh for Westfall's windswept hills. Jovial and devoted to potent spirits, he speaks only in rhymes. A traveler must complete a simple task before he answers any questions, and he is always ready to test a thirsty palate.
